title: The Ark and the Tabernacle

questions.question: What did God ask the people to give for the tabernacle?
options: An offering from every person whose heart moves him
questions.correctAnswer: An offering from every person whose heart moves him
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:2 (ESV): "Speak to the people of Israel, that they take for me a contribution. From every man whose heart moves him you shall receive the contribution."

questions.question: What was the Ark of the Covenant overlaid with?
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:11 (ESV): "You shall overlay it with pure gold, inside and outside."

questions.question: What was placed on top of the Ark?
options: A mercy seat with two cherubim
questions.correctAnswer: A mercy seat with two cherubim
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:17-18 (ESV): "You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold... And you shall make two cherubim of gold."

questions.question: What was to be placed inside the Ark?
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:16 (ESV): "And you shall put into the ark the testimony that I shall give you."

questions.question: What did the tabernacle represent?
options: A sanctuary for God to dwell among His people
questions.correctAnswer: A sanctuary for God to dwell among His people
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:8 (ESV): "Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell in their midst."

questions.question: What wood was used to build the Ark?
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:10 (ESV): "They shall make an ark of acacia wood."

questions.question: How many branches did the golden lampstand have?
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:32 (ESV): "Six branches shall go out of its sides, three branches out of one side and three out of the other."

questions.question: What was placed on the table of the Presence?
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:30 (ESV): "And you shall set the bread of the Presence on the table before me regularly."

questions.question: What were the dimensions of the Ark?
options: Two and a half cubits long, one and a half wide, one and a half high
questions.correctAnswer: Two and a half cubits long, one and a half wide, one and a half high
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:10 (ESV): "Two cubits and a half shall be its length, a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height."

questions.question: What were the rings on the Ark for?
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:14-15 (ESV): "You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark by them."

questions.question: What were the cherubim to do with their wings?
options: Spread out above, overshadowing the mercy seat, with faces toward each other
questions.correctAnswer: Spread out above, overshadowing the mercy seat, with faces toward each other
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:20 (ESV): "The cherubim shall spread out their wings above, overshadowing the mercy seat with their wings, their faces one to another."

questions.question: How much gold was used for the lampstand?
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:39 (ESV): "It shall be made, with all these utensils, out of a talent of pure gold."

questions.question: Where did God say He would meet with Moses?
options: From above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim
questions.correctAnswer: From above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:22 (ESV): "There I will meet with you, and from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim."

questions.question: What decorations were on the branches of the lampstand?
options: Cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and flowers
questions.correctAnswer: Cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and flowers
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:33 (ESV): "Three cups made like almond blossoms, each with calyx and flower."

questions.question: What instruction did God give about the tabernacle pattern?
options: Make it exactly according to the pattern shown on the mountain
questions.correctAnswer: Make it exactly according to the pattern shown on the mountain
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:9 (ESV): "Exactly as I show you concerning the pattern of the tabernacle... so you shall make it."

key_verse_text: And let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell in their midst.
